articles.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
articles.zh: CritICL：利用小语言模型失败模式的推理时弱到强泛化
articles.summary: 如果你在用弱模型监督强模型，这篇把失败模式变成推理时的纠错信号，思路很反常识。
articles.author: Yufan Wu, Yinghui He 等
articles.body: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL
articles.bodyZh: 推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）最近取得了不少进展，让大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力明显提升。不过，这些方法通常要靠反复生成或者外部验证来兜底，代价不低。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个新框架，叫 CritICL，它能在保持高效的同时提升推理表现。我们的核心发现是：同一个模型家族里，不同规模的模型在出错时会表现出某种规律性的模式。我们不再把错误当成一堆没用的输出，而是反过来利用它们来引导推理。具体来说，我们拿弱模型暴露出的失败模式做文章，把它们通过“基于批判的上下文示例”（critique-based in-context examples）塞进推理过程里。我们设计了两个版本：一个是 CritICL-dynamic，能根据输入动态预测可能踩的坑并检索对应的批判；另一个是 CritICL-static，用一套全局的失败模式档案来提供稳定指导。实验结果显示，CritICL 稳定优于标准的上下文学习（in-context learning），而且跟那些测试时扩展（test-time scaling）的方法相比，性能要么持平要么更好，但生成次数和 token 成本都低得多。代码地址：https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL

articles.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
articles.zh: WikiSkill：将Agent经验编译为持久知识以驱动技能进化
articles.summary: 如果你在做Agent的长期记忆或自我进化，这篇教你把每次完成任务的经验沉淀成可复用知识，避免重复踩坑。
articles.author: Liyan Tang, Cyrus Rashtchian 等
articles.body: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.
articles.bodyZh: Agent技能包把专业知识和操作流程打包成可复用的资源，用来扩展AI代理（agent）的能力。最近的研究可以从代理的运行经验中自动发现这类技能，让代理在反复交互中逐步适应。但这些指导技能开发的洞见通常散落在优化历史里，导致跨迭代的系统性复用很受限。我们推出了WikiSkill这个框架，让代理技能和一个持续更新的知识库（wiki）共同演进。总的来说，WikiSkill把原始执行经验、积累下来的知识和可执行的技能三者分开，同时不断把经验整合进知识库，后续的技能更新可以在此基础上继续构建。在多个基准测试和模型上，WikiSkill一直优于最先进的技能进化方法，并且在大多数“模型+基准”组合中表现超过没有技能的基线。我们发现技能进化和模型规模是互补的：更大的模型通常从进化技能中获益更多，而带技能的小模型可以超过不带技能的大得多的模型。我们还发现，进化出的技能可以在模型之间、甚至跨模型家族有效迁移，而且别的模型进化出的技能可能比自己进化的更好。最后，消融研究证实，知识库中持续的知识积累对有效的技能进化至关重要。这些结果说明，系统性地积累和提炼代理经验，对开发可复用、可迁移的技能很有价值。

articles.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance
articles.zh: SWE-Prime：更少的轨迹，更好的性能
articles.summary: 如果你觉得训练Agent数据量越多越好，这篇用SWE-bench证明轨迹筛选比数量更关键，少而精才是正解。
articles.author: Dewu Zheng, Ruizhe Ye 等
articles.body: To improve large language models' ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable problem-solving behaviors. Therefore, we propose SWE-Prime, a multi-granularity, two-stage SFT data selection method that progressively filters training data at the trajectory and segment levels. Specifically, the first stage performs trajectory-level screening based on process quality, result quality, and data representativeness, selecting a high-quality and representative subset of successful trajectories. The second stage performs segment-level selection by grouping consecutive steps into semantic segments and assessing each segment based on its contribution to the final solution, learnability, and potential risks. During SFT, all segments remain in the sequence to preserve context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss computation. Experiments on SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified show that training on the 10% trajectory subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, yielding relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%, respectively.
articles.bodyZh: 为了提升大语言模型解决真实软件问题的能力，之前的研究主要是搞大规模智能体轨迹数据集，然后在成功的轨迹上做监督微调（SFT）。但任务成功并不代表监督信号质量就高：成功轨迹里也可能混着没用的、重复的、甚至有风险的步骤。要是直接拿这种轨迹去做SFT，等于给模型塞了带噪声的监督，还会让模型学着模仿不好的解题习惯。所以我们提出了SWE-Prime，一个多粒度、两阶段的SFT数据筛选方法，先在轨迹层面、再在片段层面逐步过滤训练数据。具体来说，第一阶段做轨迹级筛选，看过程质量、结果质量和数据代表性，挑出高质量又有代表性的成功轨迹子集。第二阶段做片段级筛选，把连续步骤归成语义片段，再根据每个片段对最终答案的贡献、可学习性和潜在风险来打分筛选。在SFT的时候，所有片段还是都留在序列里，保持上下文完整，但只有选中的片段参与损失计算。在SWE-Bench Pro和SWE-Bench Verified上的实验显示，用SWE-Prime选出来的10%轨迹子集去训练，效果比用全部已解决轨迹训练还好，相对性能提升分别最高达到12.2%和24.2%。

articles.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
articles.summary: 如果你正在做推理时缩放或RL，这篇把策略优化搬到测试时进行，训练和推理的边界可能要重画了。
articles.author: Aozhe Wang, Zhengxi Lu 等
articles.body: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
articles.bodyZh:
最近一些亮眼的训练后技术，比如强化学习（RL）和同策略自蒸馏（OPSD），让大语言模型在数学推理上进步飞快。但这些方法都依赖标准答案标签，所以在测试时训练（TTT）这个场景下就玩不转了。

那用多数投票产生的伪标签来替代标准答案？听起来挺自然，但这招很脆：只要投票出错，老师就被带偏，后面每一个token都得跟着遭殃。我们还观察到这种失效模式是不对称的——不管投票本身对不对，那些和伪标签不一致的生成结果，基本上都是错的。

基于这个发现，我们提出了测试时策略优化（TTPO），也就是一个不对称的学习目标：对和伪标签一致的生成结果，用OPSD来蒸馏；对不一致的，用分组强化学习来惩罚。再加上token级别的筛选，让这两条路都更精细：蒸馏的时候会降低那些已经收敛位置的权重，强化学习则只在模型很自信但答错的地方给惩罚。

这样一来，就算伪标签经常出错，两种更新也都很稳；而且随着模型自己变强，多数投票这个路由还能给出更紧致的自我监督。完全不用任何标签，TTPO在五个竞赛级基准上追平了有标签监督的OPSD；在测试时训练里，把Qwen3-1.7B从38.0%提到了45.2%；不开启思考模式时也有+25.2%到+36.4%的提升。跨任务泛化能力同样很强。

articles.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench
articles.zh: 从静态到动态：MCR-Bench基准测试真实世界代码审查
articles.summary: 如果你在开发代码审查Agent，这个基准不再用静态伪造场景，而是模拟真实动态审查流程，测出来的结果才靠谱。
articles.author: Dewu Zheng, Yanlin Wang 等
articles.body: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming. Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce MCR-Bench, the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review. MCR-Bench covers five commonly-used programming languages and consists of 2,269 real-world multi-round code review tasks, each of which is annotated with fine-grained defect information and cross-round state labels. Each task in MCR-Bench is equipped with fine-grained defect metadata (e.g., description, type, severity) alongside dynamic state annotations, capturing the complete evolutionary trajectory of a defect throughout the multi-round process. We obtain several findings through extensive experiments on MCR-Bench with mainstream LLMs. (1) Limited overall capability: experiments reveal that mainstream LLMs exhibit limited overall performance in defect detection and defect lifecycle state tracking, with performance degrading significantly as the number of interaction rounds increases; (2) Defect-sensitive performance: LLMs' performance varies substantially across different defect types and severity levels, with semantically complex or low-salience defects being significantly more likely to be missed; (3) Underlying Failure Mechanisms: our in-depth error analysis dissects the distinct drivers of false positives and false negatives, revealing critical weaknesses such as cross-round temporal misalignment and inadequate long-range memory.
articles.bodyZh:
在真实的软件开发中，代码评审（code review）通常是开发者和评审人之间来回反复沟通、不断打磨的过程，为的是把代码质量提上去。但也正因如此，这个过程既费钱又费时间。虽然最近有不少研究开始尝试用大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）来做自动化代码评审，但大多数方法都把它简化成了一轮就完事的静态判断任务。这样做完全没抓住真实评审场景里那种多轮互动、边评边改的复杂过程。为了补上这个缺口，我们推出了MCR-Bench——这是第一个专门为真实多轮代码评审设计的、带缺陷状态感知（defect state-aware）的基准测试集。

MCR-Bench覆盖了五种常用编程语言，包含2,269个真实世界里的多轮代码评审任务。每个任务都标注了细粒度的缺陷信息，还带跨轮次的状态标签。具体来说，每个任务不仅有缺陷的元数据（比如描述、类型、严重程度），还有动态的状态标注，能够完整呈现一个缺陷在多轮评审过程中的整个演化轨迹。通过在MCR-Bench上对主流大语言模型做大量实验，我们得出了几个发现：

第一，整体能力有限。实验显示，主流大语言模型在缺陷检测和缺陷生命周期状态追踪上的表现都不怎么样，而且随着交互轮数增加，性能还会明显下滑。

第二，性能对缺陷类型很敏感。模型在不同缺陷类型和不同严重程度上的表现差异很大。那些语义复杂或者不太显眼的缺陷，被漏掉的可能性要高得多。

第三，失败机制有迹可循。我们通过深入分析错误案例，拆解了误报（false positives）和漏报（false negatives）背后各自不同的原因，暴露出一些关键短板，比如跨轮次的时间信息对不齐、长距离记忆能力不足等。

articles.title: RedEvoAgent: Automatic Red-Teaming Agent with Experience-Driven Skill Evolution
articles.zh: RedEvoAgent：经验驱动技能演化的自动红队Agent
articles.summary: 如果你做LLM安全测试，这个Agent不仅能自动找漏洞，还会从攻击经验里长出新招数，越测越难对付。
articles.author: Junjie Zhang, Hui Liu 等
articles.body: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in product-level execution harnesses, where jailbreaks can trigger harmful tool use and persistent state changes, creating greater risks than unsafe text generation alone. Existing automatic red-teaming methods often rely on fixed attacks, while recent agentic attackers coordinate multiple jailbreak tools and show stronger potential through trajectory-based retrieval. However, such retrieval can reuse misleading experiences due to retrieval bias and unclear tool credit, and full trajectories add context overhead while reducing interpretability. We propose RedEvoAgent, a black-box red-teaming agent that distills cross-case attack trajectories into a concise, human-readable attack skill. The attack skill adaptively evolves through tool-effectiveness profiling and Deciding-Tool Attribution for skill updates, and a validation ratchet that retains only updates improving validation performance. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, target models, and target execution harnesses show that RedEvoAgent outperforms fixed and agentic baselines, improves tool efficiency, and transfers across attacker models and target execution harnesses.
articles.bodyZh: 基于大语言模型的智能体（LLM-based agent）越来越多地被部署到产品级的执行框架里，这时候一旦遭遇越狱攻击（jailbreak），就可能触发有害的工具调用和持久化的状态改变，风险比单纯生成不安全文本要大得多。现有的自动化红队测试（red-teaming）方法往往依赖固定攻击，而最近出现的智能体式攻击者则会组合多种越狱工具，通过基于轨迹的检索（trajectory-based retrieval）展现出更强的攻击潜力。但这类检索有个问题：容易因为检索偏差和工具归因不清，把误导性的经验也捡进来用；同时，完整轨迹会带来额外的上下文开销，还降低了可解释性。为此我们提出了RedEvoAgent，一个黑盒（black-box）红队智能体，它能把跨案例的攻击轨迹提炼成简洁、人类可读的攻击技巧（attack skill）。这种攻击技巧会通过工具效果画像、名为Deciding-Tool Attribution的决策工具归因机制来不断自适应演化，并配有一个验证棘轮（validation ratchet），只保留那些能提升验证性能的更新。在多个基准测试、目标模型和目标执行框架上的实验表明，RedEvoAgent的表现优于固定基线和智能体式基线，工具使用效率更高，而且还能在攻击者模型和目标执行框架之间迁移。

articles.title: Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation
articles.zh: 基于图结构电子占据的离散流匹配进行反应机理预测
articles.summary: 如果你用AI做化学合成设计，这篇直接用离散流匹配建模电子状态来预测反应，属于更底层的硬核方法。
articles.author: Nguyen Xuan-Vu, Octavian Susanu 等

articles.title: Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models
articles.zh: 转导语言模型的随机估计
articles.summary: 如果你在处理转换后语言模型的概率计算或不确定性估计，这篇给出了一种随机估计思路，可能带来推理效率上的新选择。
articles.author: Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson, Samuel Kiegeland 等
articles.body: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. We show that applying this correction recursively gives an unbiased estimator of the target prefix probability and lets us estimate the mass lost by threshold pruning. Our beam-summing algorithm extends the retained source prefixes and samples which prefixes to keep, reducing their number as more probability mass is added to the running estimate. This can save computation and guarantees that the run halts with probability one. We evaluate the method on encyclopedic text and DNA against sequential Monte Carlo baselines that resample with replacement. It achieves a better compute--variance tradeoff on text and lower error at the same maximum number of particles on DNA. On a DNA-to-amino-acid transduction, it reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude relative to threshold-pruned beam summing and makes estimating prefix probabilities for long target strings feasible. Replacing threshold pruning with unbiased sampling in a published reading-time analysis substantially lowers the estimated corpus surprisal but leaves the published conclusions unchanged.
articles.bodyZh: 转导语言模型（Transduced Language Model, TLM）会把一个预训练好的源语言模型和一个函数式有限状态转换器拼在一起，从而在目标字符串上“诱导”出一个新的语言模型。要算某个目标前缀在TLM下的概率，本质上就是把所有能被转换器映射成“以该前缀开头”的目标字符串的源字符串，在源语言模型下的概率全部加起来。而这个源字符串集合可能大到指数级，甚至可能是无限的。之前的研究走了一条基于源前缀概率的计算捷径，然后拿“阈值剪枝的束求和”去近似最终的总和，这样能得到一个下界，但误差有多大是不知道的。我们的做法是：不重复地重新采样源前缀，并按每个被选中前缀的包含概率的倒数来重新加权。我们证明，递归地应用这种校正，可以给出目标前缀概率的无偏估计量，同时还能估算出阈值剪枝丢掉了多少概率质量。我们的束求和算法会不断扩展保留的源前缀，并对哪些前缀该留下做采样；随着越来越多的概率质量被加进当前的估计值，保留下来的前缀数量也会逐步减少。这能省下不少计算量，还保证了算法以概率1终止。我们拿百科文本和DNA数据做了评测，和那些使用放回重采样的顺序蒙特卡洛基线方法相比：在文本上，我们的方法在“计算量–方差”的权衡上做得更好；在DNA上，在最大粒子数相同的条件下，我们的误差更低。在一个“DNA转氨基酸”的转导任务里，相比阈值剪枝的束求和，我们的运行时间直接降了好几个数量级，让长目标字符串的前缀概率估计变成了可能。另外，在一篇已发表的阅读时间分析中，把原来的阈值剪枝换成无偏采样之后，估计出来的语料惊讶度明显降低了，但论文里的结论没有变。
